name: fBm Noise Generation
aliases: fBm Noise Generation for Cloud Density
fBm Noise Generation — Water Vapour Emulation
definition: A technique to simulate the irregular density of water droplets in clouds by generating fractal Brownian motion (fBm) noise from a pre-computed 3D noise cube.
summary: fBm Noise Generation simulates cloud density by summing pre-computed uniform noise from a 3D cube, differing from procedural methods by trading memory for deterministic, fast texture lookups.
